context: Ren interviews a researcher about a survey method.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: research interview; method vocabulary (述べ/基準/自己/知識) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 調査は、どんな基準で行うんですか?
lines.en: By what standard do you conduct the survey?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 公平な基準を、まず定めます。
lines.en: First we set a fair standard.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 対象者は、自己申告するんですか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、自己申告を基に分析を行います。
lines.en: Yes, we analyze based on self-reports.
lines.style: patient researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 個人の法律上の権利は、守られますか?
lines.style: serious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 法律に従い、情報を厳重に守ります。
lines.en: Following the law, we strictly protect information.
lines.style: firm researcher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結果は、どこで述べられますか?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文で、結論を述べる予定です。
lines.en: We plan to state the conclusions in a paper.
lines.style: composed researcher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
